metamorphism.goal: Two minerals share a boundary on the pressure-temperature map. Turning the first into the second changes its entropy from S _ 1 to S _ 2 and its molar volume from V _ 1 to V _ 2. Write s, how many pascals the boundary climbs for each kelvin.
metamorphism.name: Clapeyron slope
metamorphism.ask: Find s in Pa/K for graphite into diamond: A = 5.74, B = 2.38 J/(mol·K); X = 5.30e-6, Y = 3.42e-6 m³/mol.
metamorphism.method: Along the boundary both phases have the same Gibbs energy, so their changes match: V₁dP − S₁dT = V₂dP − S₂dT.

deep_drilling.goal: Heat flows up out of the planet at q watts per square metre through rock that conducts k watts per metre per kelvin. The surface is at T _ 0. Write the temperature T a depth h down.
deep_drilling.name: Geothermal gradient
deep_drilling.ask: Find T in kelvin at the bottom of the deepest hole, h = 12000 m, with A = 288 K, q = 0.065 W/m² and k = 2.5 W/(m·K).
deep_drilling.method: Fourier's law: the heat flow is the conductivity times how fast the temperature rises with depth.

isotope_separation.goal: In a spinning rotor a heavy and a light molecule of the same gas settle differently. Their molar masses differ by M, the wall moves at speed v and the gas is at temperature T. Write α, how much richer in the light one the gas at the axis is than at the wall.
isotope_separation.name: Centrifuge separation factor
isotope_separation.ask: Find α for uranium hexafluoride: M = 0.003 kg/mol, v = 700 m/s, R = 8.314 J/(mol·K), T = 310 K.
isotope_separation.method: Each species follows the Boltzmann law in the rotating frame, n ∝ e^(mω²r²/2RT); divide the two at the wall and at the axis.

nuclear_fission.goal: A neutron from one splitting nucleus makes η new neutrons per neutron the fuel absorbs; a fraction f of slowed neutrons are absorbed by fuel, a fraction p survive slowing down, and fast splits add a factor ε. Write k, the neutrons in the next generation per neutron in this one.
nuclear_fission.name: Four-factor formula
nuclear_fission.ask: Find k for a graphite core: n = 2.07, f = 0.71, p = 0.75, e = 1.03.
nuclear_fission.method: Follow one generation round: each step keeps or multiplies the neutron count, so the factors multiply.

magnetohydrodynamics.goal: A fluid of conductivity σ flows at speed u across a field B between two electrodes; the outside circuit takes a fraction k of the open-circuit voltage. Write p, the electrical output per cubic metre.
magnetohydrodynamics.name: Faraday generator
magnetohydrodynamics.ask: Find p in W/m³ for a seeded plasma: σ = 50 S/m, u = 1000 m/s, B = 5 T, k = 0.5.
magnetohydrodynamics.method: The current density is j = σ(uB − E) with E = k·uB at the load; the power delivered is j·E.
